career_path_block.说明: Credentials plus a strong behavioral-science foundation

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risks for animal trainers are modest pay and industry transition, not AI. AI cannot replace the relationship between trainer and animal, but traditional coercive training will lose ground. Behavioral science and positive reinforcement offer the strongest future.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risks are not AI but modest pay and physical danger. Overall earnings are low, while unpredictable behavior makes bites, scratches, and impacts routine hazards. Rising animal-welfare standards are also forcing traditional coercive performance training to change, and workers limited to old methods will gradually lose opportunities.
risks: Modest earnings: overall pay is low
Physical danger: bites, scratches, and impacts are routine hazards
Industry transition: traditional performance training is shrinking
Emotional strain from changes in an animal's condition and death
Professional value is often underestimated

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can record data and analyze behavior curves, but only a trainer's daily relationship with an animal reveals whether it avoids a movement because it is tired or afraid. Machines cannot replace that understanding, intuition, or patience with each life.

responsibilities: Develop and carry out animal-training plans
Use rewards to reinforce target behavior
Record behavior data and assess progress
Provide daily animal care and coordinate with veterinarians

career_risk_cards.callout: 动物训练师最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「低薪与行业转型」——AI 替代不了你和动物之间的关系，但传统驯兽式训练会被淘汰，学行为学、做正向强化的人才有未来。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「低薪与身体风险」：训练师整体收入不高，且动物行为不可控，被咬、被抓、被撞击是家常便饭；同时训练行业对动物福利要求越来越高，传统「逼出来」的表演型训练面临转型，只会老一套的人会慢慢被淘汰。
risks: 收入不高：整体薪资偏低
身体风险：抓咬撞击是家常便饭
行业转型：传统表演型训练收缩
情绪消耗：动物状态与离世
职业认同：价值常被低估

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能记录数据、分析行为曲线，但「它今天绕开这个动作是累了还是怕了」——这种跟动物朝夕相处才能有的默契和直觉，机器替不了，也替不了训练师对每个生命的耐心。

responsibilities: 制定并执行动物训练计划
运用奖励强化目标行为
记录行为数据并评估进度
照顾动物日常并协同兽医

career_path_block.说明: Core role in large live productions

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is knowing only traditional broadcasting methods. Versatile technicians who understand the cloud and networks and can rescue a production become more valuable as the industry transforms.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI itself, but AI-enabled production combined with workforce reductions. Automated playout, AI captions, and cloud broadcasting reduce entry-level technical roles, while on-site equipment setup, emergency repair, and complex signal chains still depend on people. Technicians who understand networks and cloud technology and can oversee live broadcasts are more secure.
risks: Contraction of traditional broadcasting roles
High live-production pressure and substantial responsibility for errors
Income volatility from project-based work
Rapid technology updates and heavy learning demands
Irregular schedules and continuous work during large events

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can automate subtitle switching, restore audio and video, and run cloud broadcasts, but when a camera falls or a cable comes loose at a live venue, a technician still has to rush in and fix it. In live broadcasting, every detail matters and the signal comes first. The light on stage depends on the people supporting it behind the scenes.

responsibilities: Set up and calibrate audio-video equipment
Monitor live broadcasts and switch signals
Troubleshoot and urgently repair equipment faults

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「只会传统广电那套」——懂云、会网络、能救场的复合技术员，行业越转型越值钱。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「AI 化制作与岗位缩编」——自动化播出、AI 字幕、云转播让基础技术岗减少，但现场设备布置、应急抢修和复杂信号链路靠人；会网络与云技术、能盯直播的技术员更稳。
risks: 传统广电岗位收缩
直播高压，出错责任大
项目制收入波动
技术更新快，学习压力大
作息不规律，大型活动连轴转

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能自动切字幕、修复音画、云上播出，但直播现场那台摄像机倒了、那根线松了，冲上去抢修的还得是技术员。直播无小事，信号大过天——台前的光，是靠台后的人撑住的。

career_path_block.可控: Use AI for speed, shift toward judgment

career_risk_cards.callout: Risk remains manageable when educators stay within responsibility boundaries and keep learning. The moat lies in execution and judgment, not repetitive work.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI, but moderate exposure plus responsibility boundaries. People retain judgment and final review while AI handles structured tasks.
risks: Responsibility and compliance-boundary pressure in Business Teachers, Postsecondary.
Structurable tasks are being replaced faster by AI.
Industry swings and tighter headcount or posts.
Knowledge turns over quickly and needs constant refreshing.
Communication overhead in cross-role collaboration.

page.contract_project_risk_block: Split moderate risk into what you can learn and what you can control: methods are learnable, process and compliance are controllable.

responsibilities: Develop and execute work plans related to Business Teachers, Postsecondary.
Take responsibility for the quality and risks of Business Teachers, Postsecondary outputs.
Coordinate resources and deliver Business Teachers, Postsecondary projects.
Review and improve Business Teachers, Postsecondary processes and methods.

skills.技能: Professional methods for Business Teachers, Postsecondary

skills.说明: Use AI and professional software well

career_path_block.可控: 用 AI 提效、转向判断

career_risk_cards.callout: 风险可控的前提是「不越责任边界 + 持续补课」——教师商业的护城河在执行与判断，不在重复劳动。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不在 AI，而在「中风险敞口 + 责任边界」——教师商业的判断与终审仍由人承担，AI 只处理可结构化任务。
risks: Business Teachers, Postsecondary领域的责任与合规边界压力。
可结构化任务被 AI 加速替代。
行业波动与编制/岗位收紧。
知识更新快，需持续补课。
跨角色协作的沟通成本。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 把中风险拆成「可学 + 可控」两块：可学的是方法，可控的是流程与合规。

responsibilities: 制定与执行Business Teachers, Postsecondary相关的工作方案。
对Business Teachers, Postsecondary产出质量与风险负责。
协调资源、推动Business Teachers, Postsecondary项目交付。
复盘优化Business Teachers, Postsecondary流程与方法。

career_path_block.路径: Computer Numerically Controlled Tool Operators (career change)

career_path_block.说明: Process judgment creates a strong barrier

career_risk_cards.callout: The largest career risk is not AI itself but remaining at the entry level. Program generation is becoming nearly free, while process judgment remains a defensible skill.
career_risk_cards.fact: The main career risk is automatic programming. Smarter CAM software and AI make entry-level toolpath generation nearly free. Template-only programmers face the most pressure, while people with strong process knowledge and difficult-part skills gain value.
risks: AI programming reduces entry-level roles
Software replaces template-only programming
Manufacturing cycles affect industry demand
Shop-floor conditions and overtime can be demanding
Ignoring multi-axis methods and new processes leads to marginalization

page.contract_project_risk_block: Most programming roles use employment contracts. Before joining, confirm shop-floor protective equipment, trial-cut overtime rules, and process-confidentiality terms. In advanced industries, review noncompete restrictions and training-service commitments. Use this guidance for career exploration, not legal, hiring, or employment decisions.

responsibilities: Write and verify CNC machining programs
Support trial cuts and optimize parameters

career_path_block.说明: 被 AI 自动编程替代

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「停在入门层」——程序生成在变免费，工艺判断才是你的护城河。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大风险是「自动编程替代」——CAM 软件越来越智能，AI 辅助编程让入门级刀路生成近乎免费，只会套模板写简单程序的人最先被挤压；工艺扎实、能解决疑难件的人才反而更值钱。
risks: AI 自动编程压缩入门编程岗位
纯模板式编程被软件替代
行业景气度随制造业波动
车间环境与加班强度不小
不学多轴与新工艺会被边缘化

page.contract_project_risk_block: 编程岗多为劳动合同制，入职确认是否配车间劳保、试切加班计算与工艺保密条款；高端行业要留意竞业限制与培训服务期约定。

responsibilities: 编写并验证数控加工程序
持续改进加工效率质量

career_path_block.说明: Legal validity requirements protect the role
AI cannot fully replace real-time performance

career_risk_cards.callout: The biggest risk in court reporting is chasing speech recognition as it absorbs mechanical transcription. People remain central in human-AI workflows that require legal validity, real-time output, and professional annotation.
career_risk_cards.fact: The main career risk is technological substitution. AI speech recognition is improving quickly, and many low-requirement meeting records and captions are already automated. Traditional stenography requires costly training and equipment, while speech recognition lowers entry barriers. Reporters must move toward legal validity, real-time performance, and professional annotation.
risks: Technological substitution: speech recognition takes lower-end work
Entry cost: stenography training and equipment are expensive
High-pressure work: sustained rapid reporting is physically demanding
Certification barriers: some roles require advanced credentials
Income divergence: freelance earnings fluctuate substantially

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can turn a recording into mostly accurate text, but one wrong word can change the meaning of a case. Accuracy, review, and accountability remain the human foundation of reporting. This is career exploration guidance, not a guarantee of employment or a hiring decision.

responsibilities: Create verbatim records of trials and meetings
Provide real-time captions and synchronized output
Review transcripts and enforce formatting standards

career_path_block.说明: 与 AI 转写直接竞争
法律效力要求护住岗位
实时性 AI 难以完全替代
专业判断 + 人机协作

career_risk_cards.callout: 法庭记录最大的风险是「被语音识别追着跑」——机械转录场景在被吃掉，但「法律效力 + 实时性 + 专业标注」这块，人机协作的模式里人仍是关键。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「技术替代」：AI 语音识别质量快速提升，低要求的会议记录、字幕场景已大量自动化；传统速记培训和设备成本高，而语音识别把入场门槛拉低，倒逼记录员向「法律效力 + 实时性 + 专业标注」升级。
risks: 技术替代：语音识别吃掉低端场景
门槛成本：速记培训与设备投入大
高压作业：长时间高速记录损耗大
认证壁垒：部分岗位证书要求高
收入分化：自由执业收入波动大

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能把录音转成九成对的文字，但「一字之差可能改写案情」——准确、把关、担责任，是机器替不了的记录底气。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is the combination of simulation and automated testing. Systems absorb routine simulation, while engineers with architecture and integration skills remain more resilient.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is the combination of simulation and automated testing. Systems accelerate routine simulation and testing, but people still define system architectures and integrate electromagnetic requirements.
risks: Simulation automation
Test automation
Production-yield variation
Technology changes quickly
Strict standards compliance

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable the system becomes, engineers still define the architecture, judge electromagnetic behavior, and integrate the system. People must think through the circuit, solder prototypes, and inspect the result.

responsibilities: Work with manufacturing teams on yield

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「仿真 + 自动化测试」——常规仿真被系统吃，有架构与集成力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「仿真 + 自动化测试」——常规仿真与测试被系统提速，但系统架构与电磁集成仍要人。
risks: 仿真自动化
测试自动化
量产波动
技术更新快
标准合规严

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，架构怎么定、电磁怎么判、系统怎么集，最后还是工程师的脑去想、手去焊、眼去看——电路这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI itself but remaining in order-taking and checkout without learning operations. Versatile workers who serve customers, understand operations, and lead shifts are more resilient as stores digitize.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk comes from self-service ordering and smart kitchen equipment. QR-code ordering, kiosks, and automated meal equipment absorb checkout and some preparation, reducing counter-only roles. Face-to-face service, flexible meal assembly, and store operations still require many workers in the near term.
risks: Self-service ordering and unattended checkout reduce counter-only roles
Pay is low, and advancement depends on management skills and persistence
Rotating shifts and standing work are demanding, contributing to high turnover
Rush periods create pressure and emotional strain
Faster automation raises skill requirements

page.contract_project_risk_block: Kiosks can handle payment and phones can take orders, but people still greet customers during rushes and pack meals quickly and accurately. Fast food is a service business. Machines streamline processes but cannot remove human warmth.

responsibilities: Greet customers and process orders and payments
Assemble meals and pack takeout orders
Keep counters clean and maintain stock

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「只做点单收银不学运营」——会服务、懂运营、能带班的多面手，才扛得住门店智能化。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险来自「自助点餐与智能厨房设备」：扫码点单、自助柜、智能配餐设备正在接管点餐收银和部分制作环节，纯柜台岗被压缩；但面对面服务、灵活配餐和门店运营，短期内仍需要大量人力。
risks: 自助点餐与无人收银压缩纯柜台岗
收入偏低，晋升靠管理和坚持
倒班与站岗辛苦，流动性高
高峰压力大，情绪消耗多
行业自动化加速，技能要求上升

page.contract_project_risk_block: 自助机替你收银、手机替你点单，但高峰时柜台前那声「您好、您要点什么」、打包时那手又快又稳的活，还得靠人。快餐是服务人的生意，机器省了流程，省不了温度。

responsibilities: 接待顾客完成点餐收银

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI alone, but regulatory technology combined with automated reporting. Systems absorb manual checks, while examiners with strong assessment and enforcement judgment remain more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk to this career is not AI alone, but regulatory technology combined with automated reporting. Systems replace manual checking, while people remain accountable for risk classification and enforcement decisions.
risks: Regulatory technology reduces manual roles
Automated reporting replacement
Regulations change quickly
High accountability pressure
Formal documents create accountability risk

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable systems become, Financial examiners still decide which institutions show warning signs, how to classify findings, and how severe enforcement action should be. Regulation cannot remove people completely because human observation, judgment, and accountability remain central.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「监管科技 + 自动报送」——手工核对被系统吃，有研判和裁量力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「监管科技 + 自动报送」——手工核对被系统替代，但风险定性与处置裁量仍要人负。
risks: 监管科技吃手工岗
自动报送替代
法规更新快
责任压力大
文书易被追责

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪家机构有隐患、怎么定性、处罚轻重谁来定，最后还是审查员的眼去看、脑去判、手去签——监管这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.label: Risk: contraction in basic roles
career_path_block.path: Move from material moving into intelligent equipment operation

career_path_block.label: Risk: systems absorb administrative work
career_path_block.path: Invest time in on-site coordination and safety management

career_path_block.label: Risk: heavy safety responsibility
career_path_block.path: Follow procedures strictly and use AI monitoring to retain evidence

career_path_block.label: Risk: physical wear
career_path_block.path: Build management experience early and move into general management

career_path_block.label: Risk: advancement ceiling
career_path_block.path: Add warehouse and logistics credentials and transition into operations management

career_risk_cards.callout: The central risk is automation of pure physical work. Supervisors remain relatively stable because they manage people and safety.
career_risk_cards.fact: Warehouses and construction sites automate more each year, but on-site supervisors still decide how to assign people and respond to incidents.
risks: Automation reduces basic jobs: AGVs and intelligent systems lower demand for pure manual moving
Systems absorb scheduling reports: administrative work loses value
Heavy safety responsibility: supervisors carry management accountability for on-site incidents
Physical and environmental wear: rotating shifts and outdoor work take a toll
Advancement ceiling: move upward into general management or laterally into specialist roles

page.contract_project_risk_block: Over the next several years, on-site supervisors will act more like commanders of human-machine operations. Systems calculate; supervisors decide, monitor, and provide backup.

responsibilities: Inspect work areas and enforce safety
skills: Intelligent warehouse and dispatch system operation

career_path_block.label: 风险一：基层岗位收缩
career_path_block.path: 从搬运工转向会操作智能设备的人

career_path_block.label: 风险二：案头活被系统接管
career_path_block.path: 把时间投到现场协调与安全管理

career_path_block.label: 风险三：安全责任重
career_path_block.path: 严格执行规程，用 AI 监控留痕自证

career_path_block.label: 风险四：体力磨损
career_path_block.path: 趁年轻积累管理经验，往综合管理走

career_path_block.label: 风险五：晋升天花板
career_path_block.path: 补仓储物流专业证书，向运营管理转

career_risk_cards.callout: 风险核心在「纯体力岗位被自动化替代」，主管因为管人管安全反而相对稳固。
career_risk_cards.fact: 仓库和工地的自动化程度逐年提高，但「人怎么安排、出事了怎么处理」仍然要现场主管拍板。
risks: 自动化压缩基层岗位：AGV 与智能系统减少纯搬运需求
排班报表外包给系统：案头活价值下降
安全责任重：现场事故主管要负管理责任
体力与环境磨损：倒班和户外作业消耗大
晋升天花板：向上要么转综合管理，要么横向转专业岗

page.contract_project_risk_block: 未来五年的现场主管，更像「人机协同的指挥官」：系统算好了，你来定、来盯、来兜底。

responsibilities: 处理突发状况与人员缺勤
skills: 智能仓储与调度系统操作

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but the combination of harsh conditions and industry contraction. Foundries impose real heat and dust exposure. Employers and roles that do not adopt automation and greener processes will decline. This assessment supports exploration, not a safety decision.
career_risk_cards.fact: The main risks are working conditions and safety. Foundries combine heat, dust, and noise, with real hazards from molten-metal splashes and machinery. Physical demands and weak youth recruitment coincide with a shrinking number of jobs, leaving an aging skilled workforce.
risks: Environmental hazards: heat, dust, and noise
Safety hazards: molten-metal splashes and machinery injuries
Industry contraction: fewer manual molding roles
Physical demands: heavy work and continuous shifts
Environmental pressure: industry upgrades and restructuring

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can predict pouring defects and optimize parameters, but workers develop the touch needed to judge mold compaction and core alignment through repeated practice.

responsibilities: Make sand molds and cores and close flasks
Assist with pouring and clean castings after breakout
Identify defects and reclaim used sand

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「环境与行业收缩」——铸造车间的高温粉尘是硬条件，不向自动化与绿色化转型的企业和岗位，都会慢慢被淘汰。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「环境与安全」——铸造车间高温、粉尘、噪声俱全，金属液溅射和机械伤害是真实风险；同时行业劳动强度大、年轻人不愿进厂，岗位总量在收缩，留下的大多是经验型老工人。
risks: 环境危害：高温、粉尘、噪声
安全风险：金属液溅射与机械伤害
行业收缩：手工造型岗位减少
体力消耗：重体力 + 三班倒
环保压力：行业整改带来的转型

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能预测浇注缺陷、优化工艺参数，但砂型紧不紧、芯子正不正——这些决定成败的手感，还得靠铸造工一锹一锹练出来。

responsibilities: 制作砂型与砂芯并合箱

career_path_block.说明: Team leadership with valuable management responsibility

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but remaining a helper without earning credentials. A persistent shortage of licensed electricians means the outcome remains in your hands.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risks are career progression and safety, not AI. Without certification, helpers cannot work independently and face persistently low income. Field work also involves electrical and height hazards. Choosing the right mentor and mastering procedures are essential foundations.
risks: Without certification, independent work is prohibited and income remains low
Electrical-shock, working-at-height, and other safety risks exist on site
Worksite conditions are demanding, with substantial mobility and seasonality
A poor mentor match or unwillingness to learn can halt progression
Prefabrication reduces low-skill support work

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can help create drawings, plan materials, and diagnose faults, but wires and screws at a worksite still require hands to connect them one by one. The value of helper work is not the errands themselves, but turning craft and time into an electrician certificate.

responsibilities: Support channel cutting, conduit installation, and wire pulling
Learn procedures and accumulate work hours

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「停在帮工不考证」——转正电工的缺口长期存在，出路在自己手里。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「成长与安全」：不持证就不能独立作业，收入长期偏低；同时现场作业接触电气与高处环境，安全风险高，跟对师傅、学好规程是立身之本。
risks: 不持证不能独立作业，收入长期偏低
现场存在触电、高处等安全风险
工地环境辛苦，流动与季节性明显
跟错师傅或不愿学习会停滞不前
低技能辅助环节随预制化收缩

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能帮你画图、排料、查故障，但工地上的电线和螺丝，还是要一双手一根根接起来。帮工的价值不是打杂本身，而是把手艺和时间攒成一张电工证。

responsibilities: 协助电工完成辅助作业

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but "filters + virtual makeup try-ons." Basic beautification is being absorbed by technology, while artists who can interpret scripts and sculpt forms gain greater stability.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but "filters + virtual makeup try-ons." Beauty filters and AR try-ons absorb some demand for everyday makeup and trials, but applying makeup on set, sculpting special effects, and making last-minute adjustments still require people.
risks: Filters reduce everyday makeup work
Virtual makeup try-ons replace trials
Unstable project flow
Intense rushed-call schedules
Consumables and hygiene

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent filters become, character interpretation, direct makeup application and sculpting, last-minute changes, safety, and hygiene still depend on makeup artists' judgment and hands. People cannot be removed from this stage of the process.

responsibilities: Monitor the camera and provide on-set touch-ups

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「滤镜 + 虚拟试妆」——基础美颜被吃，有读戏塑形力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大的风险不是 AI，而是「滤镜 + 虚拟试妆」——美颜和 AR 试妆吃掉一部分日常与试妆需求，但现场上脸、特效塑形与临场修改仍要人。
risks: 滤镜吃日常妆
虚拟试妆替代
项目不稳定
赶场强度大
耗材与卫生

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管滤镜多聪明，读角色、上脸塑形、临场改妆和安全卫生，最后还是化妆师的脑和手去定——脸面这一关，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk for neurologists is not AI but high intensity and high responsibility. AI can help interpret images, but it cannot bear responsibility for each judgment.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but high intensity and high responsibility. Every second counts in the stroke-thrombolysis window, and the cost of misdiagnosis is high. Heavy clinic volumes, night emergencies, and physician-patient communication pressure combine to make burnout widespread.
risks: Long training cycle: decade-long investment with delayed returns
High responsibility: pressure from misdiagnosis and emergency decisions
High intensity: heavy clinic volume and frequent night emergencies
Physician-patient relationship pressure: high communication and trust costs
Burnout: sustained pressure is a widespread problem

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can outline lesions on an image, but decisive and compassionate tasks such as whether to administer thrombolysis, how to speak with the family, and how to manage the patient afterward will always belong to physicians.

responsibilities: Evaluate patients and establish neurological diagnoses
Participate in stroke emergencies and multidisciplinary consultations

career_path_block.说明: 被 AI 辅助诊疗压缩价值

career_risk_cards.callout: 神经科医师最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「高强度与高责任」——AI 能帮你看片，但不能帮你扛下每一次判断的责任。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「高强度与高责任」——卒中溶栓窗口期分秒必争，误诊代价高；门诊量巨大、夜班急诊、医患沟通压力叠加，职业倦怠是行业普遍问题。
risks: 培养周期长：十年级投入，回报周期晚
高责任：误诊与急救决策压力
高强度：门诊量大、夜班急诊频繁
医患关系压力：沟通与信任成本高
职业倦怠：长期高压是普遍问题

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能把病灶圈在片子上，但「要不要溶栓、怎么跟家属谈、后续怎么管」，这些决定性和有温度的部分，永远属于医生。

responsibilities: 接诊并明确神经系统诊断
参与卒中急救与多学科会诊

career_path_block.可控: Use AI for speed, shift toward judgment

career_risk_cards.callout: Risk stays manageable as long as you do not overstep your scope and keep learning. The moat for Paperhangers lies in execution and judgment, not repetitive labor.
career_risk_cards.fact: The biggest risk in this role is not AI but medium-risk exposure combined with scope of responsibility. Judgment and final review for Paperhangers still rest with people; AI only handles structurable tasks.
risks: Pressure from responsibility and compliance boundaries in paperhanging.
Structurable tasks are being replaced faster by AI.
Industry swings and tighter headcount or posts.
Knowledge turns over quickly and needs constant refreshing.
Communication overhead in cross-role collaboration.

page.contract_project_risk_block: Split moderate risk into what you can learn and what you can control: methods are learnable, process and compliance are controllable.

responsibilities: Develop and execute paperhanging work plans.
Take responsibility for the quality and risks of paperhanging results.
Coordinate resources and drive delivery of paperhanging projects.
Review and improve paperhanging processes and methods.

skills.说明: Use AI and professional software well

career_path_block.可控: 用 AI 提效、转向判断

career_risk_cards.callout: 风险可控的前提是「不越责任边界 + 持续补课」——裱糊工的护城河在执行与判断，不在重复劳动。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不在 AI，而在「中风险敞口 + 责任边界」——裱糊工的判断与终审仍由人承担，AI 只处理可结构化任务。
risks: Paperhangers领域的责任与合规边界压力。
可结构化任务被 AI 加速替代。
行业波动与编制/岗位收紧。
知识更新快，需持续补课。
跨角色协作的沟通成本。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 把中风险拆成「可学 + 可控」两块：可学的是方法，可控的是流程与合规。

responsibilities: 制定与执行Paperhangers相关的工作方案。
对Paperhangers产出质量与风险负责。
协调资源、推动Paperhangers项目交付。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI itself but remaining at the operational level. Prepress workers who only perform layout and platemaking face replacement first, while those who understand color and process become more valuable.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk in this role is pressure from digital transformation. Digital printing and computer-to-plate technology, or CTP, eliminated traditional film platemaking, while AI layout and cloud imposition further reduce manual work. Prepress employment continues to contract, with purely operational roles replaced first.
risks: Industry contraction: declining traditional print volume reduces jobs
AI replacement: operational roles such as layout and platemaking are compressed
Low income: a clear gap compared with design and research roles
Color dependence: individual sensitivity determines the ceiling
Transition pressure: failing to learn new skills leads to displacement

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can lay out one hundred pages in one minute, but a prepress professional with process expertise must still use human eyes and hands to guarantee that the printed color matches the brand guide.

responsibilities: Complete file layout, imposition, and print adaptation
Perform color management and proof approval
Inspect file quality and output platemaking files
Work with the production floor on proof comparisons

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI 本身，而是「停在操作层」——只会排版制版的印前工最先被替代，懂色彩与工艺的反而更值钱。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险就是「数字化转型压缩」——数字印刷和直接制版（CTP）让传统胶片制版消失，AI 排版与云拼版又在压缩人工，印前岗位数量持续收缩，纯操作型岗位最先被替代。
risks: 行业收缩：传统印刷量下降，岗位减少
AI 替代：排版制版等操作型岗位被压缩
收入偏低：相对设计与研发岗差距明显
色彩依赖：个人敏感度决定上限
转型压力：不学新技能易被淘汰

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能在一分钟内排好一百页版式，但「这个颜色印出来跟品牌手册一致」的承诺，还得靠懂工艺的印前人拿眼和手去兑现。

responsibilities: 完成文件的排版拼版与印刷适配
执行色彩管理与打样确认
检查文件质量并输出制版文件
配合车间完成校样比对

career_path_block.说明: More complex properties but higher returns
From managing properties to operating assets
Eliminated in the smart property era
career_path_block.路径: Old methods based only on chasing fees

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but disputes and responsibility. AI can reduce paperwork, but managers must always face owner emotions, safety incidents, and collection challenges themselves.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but disputes and responsibility. Difficult property fee collection, frequent owner complaints, and secondary liability for safety incidents all fall on managers. Income is tied to the scale of managed projects, and changing projects means inheriting a new set of problems.
risks: Difficult property fee collection: directly linked to conflicts with owners
Complaint pressure: absorbing pressure from both sides is routine
Safety incident responsibility: secondary risks from facility problems
Project-dependent income: project scale determines the ceiling
Industry reputation: low-price competition squeezes service margins

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can calculate reports and work orders clearly, but when an owner says in the group chat that an issue must be resolved today, the manager still has to step forward. Algorithms cannot provide that trust.

responsibilities: Coordinate project budgets and property fee management
Arrange facility maintenance and outsourced services
Handle owner requests and community affairs
Organize meetings and implement rules and policies

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「纠纷与责任」——AI 能减轻文书负担，但业主情绪、安全事故和收缴难题，永远要经理自己面对。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「纠纷与责任」——物业费收缴难、业主投诉多、安全事故的连带责任都压在经理身上；收入与在管项目规模绑定，换项目等于换一摊子麻烦。
risks: 物业费收缴难：与业主矛盾直接挂钩
投诉压力：两头受气是常态
安全事故责任：设施问题的连带风险
收入依赖项目：项目规模决定天花板
行业口碑：低价竞争挤压服务利润

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能把报表和工单算得清清楚楚，但业主群里的那句「这事今天必须解决」，还得经理本人出来接住，这是算法给不了的信任。

responsibilities: 统筹项目预算与物业费管理
安排设施维护与外包服务
处理业主诉求与社区事务
组织会议并落实规章制度

career_path_block.说明: Reduced by AI documentation and warnings

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk for psychiatric technicians is not AI but occupational exposure and psychological burnout. While protecting patients, they must also learn to protect themselves.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but occupational exposure and psychological burnout. Direct contact with emotionally dysregulated patients and risks of self-harm or violence creates physical and mental strain. Night shifts, heavy workloads, and low social recognition are widespread industry challenges.
risks: Occupational exposure: violent and self-harm risk situations
Psychological burnout: prolonged emotional investment
Night-shift pressure: irregular rotating schedules
Low social recognition: professional value is underestimated
Limited income: low ceilings for entry-level roles

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can chart a patient's emotional curve, but a psychiatric technician must always be present to watch the ward tonight and reassure the patient who cannot sleep.

responsibilities: Assist with care and medication management

career_path_block.说明: 被 AI 记录预警压缩

career_risk_cards.callout: 精神科技术员最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「职业暴露与心理耗竭」——守得住患者，也要学会守住自己。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「职业暴露与心理耗竭」——直接面对情绪失控、自伤暴力风险的患者，身心都顶着压力；夜班、高负荷和低社会认可度是行业普遍困境。
risks: 职业暴露：暴力、自伤风险场景
心理耗竭：长期高情绪投入
夜班压力：轮班作息不规律
社会认可度低：职业价值被低估
收入有限：基层岗位天花板低

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能替患者画出情绪曲线，但「今晚谁来守病房、谁去安抚那位失眠的患者」，永远需要精神科技术员在场。

career_path_block.路径: Begin in passenger or freight service

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but responsibility and physical endurance. Your judgment must withstand pressure most at critical moments.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk in this role is not AI but responsibility and physical demands. Rotating shifts, long periods en route, emergency-response pressure, and structural adjustments in a highly regulated railway industry all create strain.
risks: Rotating shifts and long trips affect schedules and family life
Heavy responsibility: any missed step can cause an incident
High emergency pressure from delays, passenger disputes, and equipment faults
Automation adjusts role structures and reduces some operational positions
Advancement depends on seniority and assessment and moves slowly

page.contract_project_risk_block: Systems can optimize consists and record every document automatically, but when passengers gather after a delay or sudden weather demands a stop in the freight yard, conductors and yardmasters still provide the judgment. That is why field command exists.

responsibilities: Operating records, reports, and shift handovers
skills: Railway safety rules and work standards

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「责任与体能」——这份工作越到关键时刻，越需要你的判断扛得住。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「责任与体力」——倒班制度、长时间在途、突发状况的处理压力，以及铁路行业本身高度规范化带来的岗位结构调整。
risks: 倒班制度与长期在途，作息和家庭生活受影响
责任重大：任何环节的疏漏都可能酿成事故
突发状况压力大：晚点、旅客纠纷、设备故障
岗位结构随自动化调整，部分操作岗被压缩
晋升通道依赖资历与考核，节奏较慢

page.contract_project_risk_block: 系统能算最优编组、能自动记录每张单据，但列车晚点时旅客围过来的那一刻、天气突变时货场里那一句「先停」，还是得靠列车长和场长的判断——这就是现场指挥存在的理由。

responsibilities: 发车前检查与途中巡视
旅客/货物事务处置与交接
调车作业指挥与安全监督
skills: 铁路安全规章与作业标准

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but tools + self-service. Standard configuration is automated, while people who build technical trust become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risk is not AI, but configuration tools + self-service selection. Standard solutions are accelerated and technical documents generated, but people still cultivate technical trust in complex scenarios.
risks: Configuration tools absorb standard proposals
Replacement by self-service selection
Technical documents are generated
High performance volatility
Enters parameters without diagnosing needs

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how smart tools become, sales engineers still decide which scenarios deserve pursuit, how to translate them into returns, and how to control integration risks. Their minds develop the approach, voices communicate it, and hands close the deal. People cannot be fully removed from technology revenue.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「工具 + 自助」——标准配置被接手，有技术信任力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不是 AI，而是「配置工具 + 自助选型」——标准方案被加速，且技术文档被生成；但复杂场景的技术信任仍要人经营。
risks: 配置工具吃标准案
自助选型替代
技术文档被生成
业绩波动大
只填参数不诊断

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多聪明，哪类场景值得攻、怎么讲成回报、集成风险怎么控，最后还是销售工程师的脑去想、嘴去讲、手去签——技术营收这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but mechanization + physical demands. Equipment is gradually taking over rough work, while hardship and dust remain part of daily life.
career_risk_cards.fact: Occupational risks mainly come from mechanized sanding + physical demands. Automated sanding and spraying reduce some tasks, but irregular joints and precision leveling still depend on people. Construction sites are dusty and highly mobile.
risks: Occupational health risks from dust and bending
Automated sanding takes over large surfaces
Project mobility and instability
Physical strain and repetition
Craftsmanship requires accumulated experience

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how well machines sand, people still handle the inside-corner joint, repair the crack, and uphold the crack-prevention standard. Humans cannot be fully removed from wall finishing.

responsibilities: Smooth and apply tape to prevent cracks
Clean and coordinate with the next trade

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「机械化 + 体力」——粗活在被设备慢慢吃掉，苦和尘是日常。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位风险主要来自「机械化打磨 + 体力」：自动打磨与喷涂降低部分工序，但异形接缝和精平仍靠人；工地环境尘土大、流动性强。
risks: 尘土与弯腰职业健康
自动打磨吃大面
工地流动与不稳定
体力与重复消耗
手艺门槛靠积累

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管机器多能磨，阴角那道缝、裂缝那次修补、和那句防裂的规矩，还是人守——墙面这头，人撤不干净。
